auth.title: Sign In to TyPusEnglish
auth.subtitle: Passwordless sign-in via Email Magic Link
auth.sentSuccess: Link sent! Please check your email inbox.
auth.requestFailed: We could not send the link. Check the address and try again.
auth.registerDescription: Choose a workspace to begin. We will verify your email before creating your account.
auth.registerTutor: Register as a tutor or teacher
auth.onboardingDescription: Your email is verified. Choose the space you want to set up.
auth.workspaceDescription: Switch spaces at any time. Each workspace is checked against your account roles.
auth.verifyRequestDescription: If the address can receive sign-in links, a message is on its way. The link expires after 15 minutes.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a little while and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This sign-in link is invalid or has already been used. Request a new link.
errors.linkExpired: This sign-in link has expired. Request a new link.
errors.invitationInvalid: This invitation is invalid or can no longer be used.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: This account does not have access to that workspace.
errors.internal: We could not complete the request. Try again.

auth.roleHint: You can create a Tutor or Independent Learner workspace after email verification.
